about: Blind two-choice test of the Qwen3-8B meme labels. Each item gives a label and two corpus sentences: one the unit fires on strongly (activation rank 9 to 30, never one the labeller saw) and a control from the same group of works, length-matched, at or below the unit's median. Groups: named31 = the 31 labels in results/labels.json; wf120 = 40 drawn at random from the eligible labels in results/labels_wf.json. Built by the robustness review (seed 20261020); judged blind by the review's workflow, which kept only the per-group tally.
instructions_for_judge: Each item gives a label describing what a neuron responds to, and two sentences a and b. Exactly one of the two is a sentence the neuron fires strongly on. Say which (a or b).
